simple.meaning: יִשְׁמָעֵאלִי (Yishmâʻêʼlîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a Jishmaelite or descendant of Jishmael.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 8 times across Genesis, Judges, 1 Chronicles, Psalms, beginning at Genesis 37:25. Its contexts include family, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יִשְׁמָעֵאלִי (H3459).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: יִשְׁמָעֵאלִי (Yishmâʻêʼlîy) / H3459 is traced through Genesis 37:25, Genesis 37:27, Genesis 37:28, Genesis 39:1 as a generated source-based concept entry.
